Chose Serverless App Engine (SAE) for 8 microservices (auth, user, driver, ride, routing, pricing, payment, notification). Open questions: specific instance sizes, backup policies, and integration details for third-party services like maps or payment gateways.

turns.ask: We're a Singapore fintech and customer data must stay in Singapore. Design a web app with a database for our customer portal.

ops.text: I'll design a secure fintech customer portal in Singapore with ESA, WAF, ALB, ECS, Tair cache and RDS.
Customer data must stay in Singapore

ops.label: Fintech customers
ops.why: Customers accessing the portal over the internet.

ops.label: Cloud DNS
ops.why: Resolves the portal domain to ESA.

ops.label: ESA
ops.why: Accelerates portal traffic and provides edge DDoS protection.

ops.label: ALB
ops.why: Distributes portal traffic across two zones.

ops.label: WAF
ops.why: Blocks OWASP attacks and bots on the portal.

ops.label: TLS certificate
ops.why: Terminates HTTPS for the customer portal.

ops.label: Portal servers
ops.why: Runs the web app across two availability zones.

ops.label: Auto Scaling
ops.why: Scales portal servers during peak trading hours.

ops.text: Sessions go to Tair and customer records to RDS, both multi-zone. KMS encrypts data at rest.

ops.label: Session cache
ops.why: Stores sessions and tokens for fast access.

ops.label: Customer DB
ops.why: Holds customer financial data with zone redundancy.

ops.label: KMS
ops.why: Encrypts database and storage keys for compliance.

ops.label: Documents
ops.why: Stores KYC documents and statements securely.

ops.label: Audit logs
ops.why: Centralizes audit logs for regulatory compliance.

ops.summary: Singapore-only fintech portal with ESA, ALB+WAF, multi-zone ECS, Tair, RDS, OSS, KMS encryption and SLS audit logging.

Please keep in mind that local regulations require all customer data to remain physically within Malaysia at all times.

Customer data stays in Malaysia

ops.why: Customers browsing the store from browsers or apps.

ops.why: Caches storefront pages and product images close to shoppers.

ops.label: ALB
ops.why: Routes storefront and order API traffic across two zones.

ops.label: WAF
ops.why: Blocks injection attacks and bots before the app.

ops.label: Auto Scaling
ops.why: Scales order API under heavy checkout load.

ops.why: Keeps carts and sessions fast across both zones.

ops.label: Orders DB
ops.why: Stores customer and order data locally in Malaysia.

ops.label: Product images

ops.label: Logs
ops.why: Central logs and alerts kept within Malaysia.

turns.summary: The user requested a ride-hailing backend for Indonesia, mandating local data residency and excluding Kubernetes. The assistant designed a solution in the Jakarta region using Serverless App Engine (SAE) to host eight microservices (auth, rider, driver, match, trip, fare, payment, notify), satisfying the no-Kubernetes constraint. Traffic flows through DNS and Edge Security Acceleration (ESA) to a Cloud-native API Gateway protected by WAF. Data persistence uses RDS MySQL and Tair Redis, both located in Jakarta zones A/B. Supporting components include OSS for media, SLS for logs, and NAT gateways. All resources remain within the specified VPC and region to ensure compliance with Indonesian data sovereignty requirements.
